questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements

Statements:

No river is a mountain.

Some rivers are animals.

Some birds are mountains.

Conclusions:

I: No animal is a mountain.

II: No river is a bird.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d8cc0527a030d21f05344484b187e7bf0c43aa578953fa7d00e7a28ea4c6a78.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No animal is a mountain → Does not follow (As no river is a mountain and some rivers are animals. As no direct relation is given between animals and mountains, therefore it is false.)

II. No river is a bird → Does not follow (As no river is a mountain and some birds are mountains. As no direct relation is given between river and bird, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(18, 378, 7)

(14, 210, 5)
questions.solution:
**The logic followed here is: (**1st number × 3rd number × 3) = 2nd number 

(18, 378, 7)

__**18 × 7 × 3**__ = 378

378 = 378 (LHS = RHS)

And,

(14, 210, 5)

__**14 × 5 × 3**__ = 210

210 = 210 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (15, 405, 9)

__15 × 9 × 3__ = 405

**405 = 405 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 2) (23, 230, 5)

__23 × 5 × 3__ = 230

345 ≠ 230 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) (17, 204, 6)

__17 × 6 × 3__ = 204

306 ≠ 204 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) (17, 272, 8)

__17 × 8 × 3__ = 272

408 ≠ 272 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options, '(15, 405, 9)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
